calibration_method.instructions: Which calibration approach best improves actual r1 fidelity and editable SVG while retaining honest validation boundaries?

criteria.semantic_reconstruction: Measure a small number of semantic visible regions, preserve identity/pose geometry, fit smooth analytic material fields, render and compare fixed regions; separately test whether another agent can use the Skill. Requires explicit geometry and careful masking.
criteria.new_freehand: Ask an agent to freely redraw r1 from verbal cues again with stronger instructions. Less tooling, but previous repeats lost layout/identity and eye form.
criteria.global_palette_trace: Globally quantize raster pixels into many palette paths. Can approximate pixels quickly but risks transferring texture, color bands, poor semantics and masking failures.

reference_policy.instructions: How should the current watermarked r1 be used during geometry/paint calibration without changing the visual target?

criteria.fixed_exclusion: Retain original bytes, freeze a tight watermark exclusion mask before candidates and compare all other visible subject regions; output artwork contains no watermark. No invented replacement pixels enter ground truth.
criteria.edit_then_trust: Use a generative cleanup of the complete reference as the new sole target. Removes the watermark but may resynthesize untouched geometry/colors and obscure what was original.
criteria.ignore_large_corner: Exclude a broad lower-right region to avoid watermark work. Easy but could hide head-fin/hair mismatch and inflate agreement.
